description: Python-specific best practices and rules for lunar_mining_sim project

avoid_sys_path_hacks.description: Never use sys.path.insert() or sys.path.append(). Package should be properly installed.
avoid_sys_path_hacks.fix: Install package with 'pip install -e .' and use proper imports

use_absolute_imports.description: Prefer absolute imports from installed package over relative imports
use_absolute_imports.fix: Use 'from lunar_mining_sim.core import ...' instead of 'from ..core import ...' in scripts

import_organization.description: Follow PEP 8 import ordering: standard library, third-party, local

use_pathlib.description: Always use pathlib.Path for path operations, never os.path

use_centralized_resolver.description: Use path_resolver utility for project root, data dir, config dir

avoid_hardcoded_paths.description: Never hardcode paths relative to __file__ or cwd
avoid_hardcoded_paths.fix: Use path_resolver utilities or environment variables

proper_installation.description: Package must be installable via 'pip install -e .'
proper_installation.check: Run 'pip install -e .' and verify imports work without sys.path hacks

script_entry_points.description: Scripts should work when package is installed, not just in development
script_entry_points.fix: Use entry points in pyproject.toml or ensure scripts can import from installed package

no_sys_path_in_tests.description: Tests should not modify sys.path. Package should be installed.
no_sys_path_in_tests.fix: Install package before running tests: 'pip install -e .'

use_pytest.description: Prefer pytest over unittest for better features and plugins
use_pytest.note: Current tests use unittest, migration to pytest is optional

shell_compatibility.description: Documentation and scripts should work on both Windows (PowerShell) and Linux (bash)
shell_compatibility.fix: Use ';' for PowerShell, '&&' for bash, or provide both examples

path_separators.description: Always use pathlib.Path or os.path.join, never hardcode '/' or '\'

remove_todos.description: Remove outdated TODO comments. Create GitHub issues for future work.
remove_todos.note: TODOs from reorganization are outdated and should be removed

type_hints.description: Add type hints to function signatures for better IDE support
type_hints.note: Gradually add type hints, not required immediately

docstrings.description: All public functions should have docstrings

sys_path_hacks.description: Using sys.path hacks instead of proper package installation
sys_path_hacks.impact: Fragile, breaks on reorganization, code smell

hardcoded_paths.impact: Breaks when files are moved or package is installed

powerShell_commands.description: Using && in commands that will run in PowerShell
